result.document_summary: A mis-scraped chunk of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Government) covering city property sales to public agencies and SDSU and Administrative Code personnel provisions, with no section 98.1103 algorithmic-device text despite the source URL.
result.notes: This part contains no rules in scope. The text is Chapter 2 (Government) of the San Diego Municipal Code: sales of City real property to public agencies and SDSU (§§ 22.0907, 22.0908) and administrative/personnel provisions (§§ 22.1001-22.1008). The URL suggests §98.1103 (use and sale of algorithmic devices prohibited), but that section's text does not appear in this part, so no algorithmic_rent_setting rule can be extracted from it.
